title: Recruiters chatting about the covert program at Starbucks
place_text: near Baker Victory Services, New York

tellings.quote: they would go to the Starbucks around the corner or whatever and talk casually about their job, which is recruiting for this UFO covert program.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, interviews a man named Jordan, who says he was taken into a secret UFO programme as a child. Michels says Jordan's blog post describes recruiters, around 2008 to 2010, who worked near a place in New York called Baker Victory Services and would go to the Starbucks around the corner to chat casually about their job: recruiting for this covert programme.
